name: mnemonic_retro_causality
label: Echo Reversal Protocol
godotFeature: Saving and restoring Node states via GDScript, utilizing Tween for visual rewind effects and ShaderMaterial for temporal distortion visuals on affected objects. Leverages RigidBody3D state management for physics objects.
poeticVision: Feel the desperate pang of choice: rewind the crumbling path before you, securing your escape from the Silence's grasp, but watch as a precious, irreplaceable fragment of your own past dissolves in your hand, its light fading forever. Every retreat from danger is a step deeper into the abyss of self-loss, a chilling calculus of survival where self-erasure is the price of existence.

parameters.name: rewind_duration
parameters.description: The duration (in seconds) for which the MemoryObject remains in its rewound, intact state.

parameters.name: temporal_distortion_material
parameters.description: A ShaderMaterial resource that uses the 'temporal_distortion.gdshader' to apply visual effects during the rewind.

verdict: A chilling calculus of survival, this protocol transforms every escape into an agonizing choice, etching the price of existence into the very fabric of Lyra's fading self.
impact: This mechanic will fundamentally alter the player's relationship with survival and identity. Every use of the Echo Reversal Protocol will be a moment of profound internal conflict, forcing players to weigh immediate physical safety against the irreversible loss of Lyra's past. It transforms a typical "escape" ability into a poignant act of self-sacrifice, deepening the emotional stakes of every encounter and making the player truly feel the "grief of self-loss" as Lyra's identity slowly erodes.
